t: Din debarim habbaim beyom tob chutz lattechum
s: Din debarim habbaim beyom tob chutz lattechum ubo k"d seipim: nokri shehebi doron leyisrael mine perot sheyyesh meoto hammin bimchubbar laqqarqa, sheyyesh lomar sheellu shehebi hayu mechubbarin laqqarqa bitchillat kenisat yom tob, veken im hebi mine baale chayyim sheyyesh meoto hammin mechussar tzida, sheyyesh lomar sheellu shehebi hayu mechussarin tzida bitchillat kenisat yom tob — hare ellu asurin baakila ubetiltul ad haereb. Vaapillu abar o shakach venatan letok piv — asur libloa, ella yiplot miyyad kedin kol maakalot asurot. Vaapillu laereb enan muttarin ella leachar shehimtin bikde sheyyeasu (perush bikde sheyyelek hannokri lemaqom shelliqqet o tzad mishsham veyigmor hammelaka veyachazor lekan kemo sheyyitbaer), dekevan shehebi haddoron leyisrael bevadday liqqet o tzad lishmo, vekol hammebi doron hu mitkavven lehabi min hammeshubbach vehammubchar veyabi meotan shelliqqet vetzad hayyom, venimtza sheasa hannokri melaka gemura beyom tob letzorek hayyisrael, lepikak hitzriku chakamim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, shello yehaneh kelum mimmeleket yom tob hannaaset bishbil yisrael. Umittaam zeh apillu adam acher shello huba bishbilo tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, shello yehaneh mimmeleket yom tob. Ulepi zeh hattaam, im hebi beyom tob rishon — muttarim baakila beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot leachar shehimtin leereb kenisat yom tob sheni bikde sheyyeasu. Veap al pi shei epshar laasot melaka zo beereb zeh shehu yom tob venimtza shenneheneh mimmah shehebi hannokri beyom tob, mikkol maqom, mimma napshak: im ereb zeh hu yom tob — hare yom tob rishon shehuba bo haya chol veeno tzarik lehamtin kelal. Umikkol maqom, qodem shehimtin bikde sheyyeasu asurin gam ken betiltul, kevan shehayyom hu yom tob vehen en reuyin adayin laakila, vekol sheeno rauy laakila asur letaltelo beyom tob. Abal im hebi lo beyom tob shechal lihyot beereb shabbat, kevan sheshshene hayyamim hen qedoshim bevadday — tzarik lehamtin bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, sheim lo yamtin veyokal miyyad — hare neheneh mimmeleket yom tob, shehare im lo haya mebi lo beyom tob lo haya yakol lehanot mehen behetter ella im ken haya mebi lo bemotzae shabbat, lepikak tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyelek lesham veyabi. Vehu haddin beyom tob shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat vehebi lo beshabbat, sheasurin ad sheyyamtin bemotzae yom tob bikde sheyyeasu. Veken haddin bishne yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana, sheshshene hayyamim hen qedoshim bevadday kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"r, lepikak im hebi lo beyom tob rishon tzarik lehamtin bemotzae yom tob sheni bikde sheyyeasu, shello yehaneh mimmeleket yom tob. Veyesh omerim shemmah shehitzriku chakamim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu en hattaam mippene sheasur lehanot mimmeleket yom tob, ella shechasheshu chakamim im nattir lo lehanot bemotzae yom tob miyyad min hammelaka shennaaset bishbilo beyom tob shemma yomar lehannokri sheyyabi lo beyom tob kede lemaher akilato belel motzae yom tob, sheissur amira lenokri hu qal beene habberiyyot, lepikak hitzrikuhu lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, deaz kevan shello yarviach kelum bemah shehebi beyom tob lo yaaseh issur bechinnam. Ulepi dibrehem, en tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu ella mi shehannokri hebi bishbilo, veken anshe beto kamohu, abal adam acher shello huba bishbilo muttar leekol mehem bemotzae yom tob miyyad, dekevan shello hitzriku lehamtin ella kede shello yomar lehannokri sheyyabi lo beyom tob, im ken day lanu im neesor al mi shehuba bishbilo, shehare im mi shehuba bishbilo, dehaynu mi sheyyetzavveh et hannokri sheyyabi beyom tob yitztarek lehamtin, im ken shub en lachush sheyyomar shum adam lenokri sheyyabi beyom tob kede shechabero yemaher akilato belel motzae yom tob, kevan shehu beatzmo lo yarviach kelum baamira zo — en adam chote velo lo. Ulepi sebara zo, im hebi lo beyom tob rishon — tzerikim hu veanshe beto lehamtin bemotzae yom tob sheni bikde sheyyeasu ap im hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, veap al pi shemmimma napshak echad mehem hu chol, mikkol maqom, kevan sheakshav aseru lanu chakamim laasot melaka bishne hayyamim, im nattir lo beyom tob sheni bemah shehuba bishbilo beyom tob rishon — yesh lachush shemma yomar lehannokri sheyyabi lo beyom tob rishon kede sheyyemaher akilato belel motzae yom tob sheni. Umikkol maqom, en issur ella baakila, abal letaltel muttar miyyad bemotzae yom tob rishon apillu qodem shehimtin bikde sheyyeasu, vaapillu hu shabbat o yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, dekevan shelleadam acher muttar apillu baakila — en lezeh din muqtzeh kelal, veap hu beatzmo muttar letaltel, shehare dabar zeh rauy laakila lekol bene adam, veen issur ella lo uleanshe beto. Veim chal yom tob bachamishi ubashshishshi — muttar lo leekol beshabbat shelleacharehen mah shehebi lo beyom tob rishon, ubilbad sheyyamtin belel shabbat bikde sheyyeasu lepi sebara zo, veen lachush shemma yomar lehannokri sheyyabi beyom tob rishon kede sheyyokal mizzeh beshabbat, kevan sheyyesh adayin shene yamim ad hashshabbat. Abal im hebi lo beyom tob sheni, dehaynu beereb shabbat — tzarik lehamtin ad motzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu ap lepi sebara harishona, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Uleinyan halaka, kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir kisbara haacharona. Venohagin lehachamir apillu leadam acher shello huba bishbilo sheyyamtin ad motzae yom tob sheni bikde sheyyeasu ap beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot. Ulepikak nohagin lehachamir apillu betiltul ad motzae yom tob sheni, kevan sheeno rauy laakila leshum adam. Veim motzae yom tob sheni hu shabbat — (en metaltelin ad sheyyamtin belel shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, umikkol maqom beyom tob sheni shehu ereb shabbat) muttar lebashshelo al yede nokri (beinyan sheen bo mishshum bishshule nokrim, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman qy"g ayyen sham) letzorek akilat shabbat leachar sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kevan sheissur hattiltul beyom tob sheni eno ella chumra bealma, lepikak yesh lehaqel al yede nokri. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh lo mimmin zeh betok beto likbod shabbat, abal im en lo mimmin zeh betok beto vehu tzarik lo likbod hashshabbat — muttar letaltelo ulebashshelo beatzmo likbod hashshabbat leachar shehimtin bemotzae yom tob rishon bikde sheyyeasu, raq sheyyizzaher millitom mimmennu ad sheyyamtin belel shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Veim yesh orechim semukim al shulchano beyom tob, ben shebbau elayv qodem yom tob, ben shezzimmen otam beyom tob leachar shehebi hannokri elayv et haddoron, im haorechin hen meir acheret sheyyesh kan mitzvat haknasat orechim — muttar lehaakilam beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot mah shehebi lo hannokri beyom tob rishon, veap hu atzmo shehuba bishbilo muttar lo leekol immahem, deen zeh kebodam shello yokal immahem, vekevan sheyyesh kan mitzvat haknasat orechim — yesh lismok al sebara harishona. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen lo mimmin zeh betok beto vehu tzarik lo likbod haorechim, vehu haddin im tzarik lo letzorek shear seuddot mitzva. Abal im yesh lo mimmin zeh betok beto shemmaspiq lo lekol bene hasseudda — en litten lipnehem mimmin zeh kede sheyyaakil leanshe beto mimmah sheyyesh lo betok beto. Vekol zeh leachar shehimtin bemotzae yom tob rishon bikde sheyyeasu, abal qodem shiur zeh — asur ben baakila ben betiltul, ben lo ben laacherim shello huba bishbilam, kemo shennitbaer lemala lepi sebara harishona, ki ken haskamat rob hammorim*veap al pi shebbesimman shakah bearnu deiqqar hattaam bekol maqom shehitzriku lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu hu mishshum gezera shemma yomar lannokri laasot kemo shennitbaer lepi sebara haacharona, veim ken haya rauy shello leesor ella al mi shehammelaka naaset bishbilo kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom lo ratzu chakamim lechalleq bigzeratam veaseru al hakkol ap al mi shello naaset bishbilo ad leachar bikde sheyyeasu, lepi sherau chakamim lehachamir harbeh bedabar shennaasa bo melaka gemura al yede nokri. Umikkol maqom leachar shehimtin belel motzae yom tob a' kede sheyyeasu — rauy lehaqel ap im hu yom tob b' shel galuyyot, kemo shennitbaer bisbara harishona, veap al pi sheadayin lo yatzanu mide chashash shemma yomar lenokri sheyyabi lo beyom tob a' kede sheyyukal lehanot mehen beyom tob b' achar hamtanat bikde sheyyeasu, mikkol maqom lo ratzu lehachamir kol kak behamtana zo sheyyamtin ad motzae yom tob b' bikde sheyyeasu, kevan shehamtana zo enah ella qenas bealma, shello yomar lehannokri sheyyaaseh ken paam acheret, im ken kevan sheqqenasuhu umenauhu millehanot mizzeh bemotzae yom tob a' miyyad ad leachar sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu — day bekak, ki bezeh yihyeh lo hekker zikkaron shello yomar lehannokri sheyyaaseh ken paam acheret..

Shiur bikde sheyyeasu hu: kede sheyyelek hannokri bemotzae yom tob mishshechasheka mibbeto lemaqom shelliqqet happerot, o lemaqom shetztzad haddagim, veyigmor hammelaka veyachazor lekan. Veim nistappeq lo mehekan hebian hannokri — en tzarik lehamtin raq bikde sheyyabou michutz lattechum. Im hebian hannokri rokeb al hassus — en tzarik lehamtin raq bikde sheshshaha hannokri birkiba zo ad shehebian lekan.

Vekol zeh benokri shehebi doron leyisrael, demin hassetam liqqet o tzad hayyom bishbil hayyisrael shehebi lo kemo shennitbaer lemala, abal im hu beinyan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma nilqat venitztzod meetmol, vegam yesh lehistappeq shemma liqqet vetzad letzorko o letzorek nokri acher veachar kak nimlak vehebian leyisrael, kevan sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel — hare ellu muttarim baakila bemotzae yom tob miyyad, veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu. Abal im en kan ella sapeq echad, shemma nilqetu venitztzodu meetmol bishbil yisrael, o shemma liqqet vetzad hayyom ubishbil nokri veachar kak nimlak vehebian leyisrael — tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, lepi shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", dehaynu achar sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu, lepikak en omerim kan: sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel.

Vekol zeh leinyan hamtanat bikde sheyyeasu bemotzae yom tob, abal beyom tob atzmo, apillu im yadua shelliqqet vetzad letzorek nokri, ella sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma liqqet vetzad hayyom, veken perot hannimtzaim tachat hailan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma nasheru mehailan beyom tob — hare ellu asurim baakila ubetiltul ad haereb, apillu im hu beinyan sheen bahen mishshum muqtzeh, kegon deqel haomed bachatzero vehayeta dato meereb yom tob al hattemarim sheyyashshir haruach min haddeqel beyom tob, o sheshshama minnokri beereb yom tob sheamar: "lemachar etlosh perot hallalu", utelashan beyom tob letzorko — hare hen asurim leyisrael baakila ubetiltul, lepi shechakamim gazeru al kol dabar shenneeqar mehammechubbar beshabbat o beyom tob leosro baakila bo bayyom im hu debar maakal, ulehishtammesh bo im eno debar maakal, mishshum gezera shemma yitlosh beatzmo, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b, vekevan sheasur leoklo ulehishtammesh bo — asur gam ken letaltelo, shehare eno rauy liklum bo bayyom. Vaapillu besapeq hechemiru chakamim ap beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot, veap al pi sheyyom tob sheni shel galuyyot eno ella mechamat sapeq, venimtza sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, mikkol maqom, kevan shekkebar hinhigu chakamim et kol bene haggola laasot shene yamim — hare hu kevadday shel dibrehem leinyan zeh shello lehattir bo sepeq muqtzeh, sheiqqar issur hammuqtzeh beshabbat hu seyag leissure tora, shello yaaleh veyitlosh kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b, o mishshum gader lehotzaa kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch, lepikak hechemiru bispeqo ap beyom tob sheni, kede shello lechalleq beno larishon. Abal leinyan shear debarim en dino kevadday shel dibrehem ella kesapeq, ukemo sheyyitbaer.

Im happerot nikkarim shello nitleshu hayyom, kegon shehen kemushin, veken im nikkarim haddagim shennitztzodu meereb yom tob, kegon shennas lechan veadmumit shettachat lechayehen shebbodeqin otan sham — muttarin ap lemi shehubeu bishbilo, im yadua shebbau mittok hattechum. Vehu haddin im hubeu lo bitchillat lel yom tob rishon beinyan shebbevadday nilqetu venitztzodu meereb yom tob.

Apillu im yadua shennilqetu venitztzodu hayyom, im yadua shello liqqet vetzad bishbil yisrael — muttarin laereb apillu hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, shehare mimma napshak echad mehen hu chol. Abal im hu yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, apillu im hu sapeq im nitlash venitztzod beyom tob rishon — asur baakila ubetiltul gam bashsheni ad haereb, lepi sheshshene hayyamim hen qedushsha achat ukeyom echad arok hen.

Veken sapeq shennitlash venitztzod beyom tob, apillu hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot — asur baakila ubetiltul gam beshabbat shelleacharayv, lepi sheal yede telisha zo o tzida zo hen mukanin laakila, veen yom tob mekin leshabbat. Veissur hakana zo enah ella middibre soperim, shehare min hattora muttar leoklan bo bayyom shennitleshu venitztzodu bo, veim ken yom tob leatzmo hekin, ella kevan shemmiddibre soperim asur leoklan bayyom shennitleshu venitztzodu bo ella bayyom shelleacharayv — nimtza sheyyom tob hekin leshabbat shelleacharayv.

Veken haddin beyom tob shelleachar hashshabbat, shehapperot shennitleshu beshabbat asurim gam beyom tob shelleacharayv, veissuran eno ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beperot hanneekalin chayyin belo bishshul, sheyyakol leoklam beshabbat atzmah min hattora, abal beperot sheenan neekalin chayyim, kevan sheenan reuyim laakila beshabbat atzmah, sheasur lebashshelan, nimtza sheshshabbat hekina leyom tob shelleacharayv, lepikak hen asurin min hattora beyom tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beperot shennitleshu beshabbat, abal bedagim shennitztzodu beshabbat, ap al pi sheenan neekalim chayyim — ap al pi ken enan asurim beyom tob shelleacharayv ella middibre soperim, lepi shehatztzida beatzmah enah niqret hakana kelal, shehare en naaseh shum shinnuy begup haddag al yede hatztzida, ella kevan sheim haya nitztzod beyom tob atzmo lo haya epshar leoklam bo bayyom mechamat gezerat chakamim, veim hannitztzod beshabbat yehe muttar beyom tob nimtza sheal yede hatztzida shebbeshabbat huttar laakila beyom tob, vahare zeh domeh keillu shabbat hekina leyom tob, veasur middibre soperim.

Rosh hashshana shechal lihyot bachamishi ubashshishshi, perot shennitleshu vedagim shennitztzodu bachamishi, apillu nitleshu venitztzodu bishbil nokri, o shennitleshu venitztzodu mealehen — hare hen asurim baakila ubetiltul gam beshabbat shelleacharehen, kemo sheim hayu nitlashin venitztzodin bashshishshi shehayu asurin gam beshabbat mishshum issur hakana, shehare shene yamim ellu hen keyom echad arok. Abal bemotzae shabbat muttarin baakila miyyad, apillu nitlash venitztzod bachamishi bishbil yisrael — en tzarik lehamtin bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Abal nitlash venitztzod bashshishshi bishbil yisrael — tzarik lehamtin bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, kemo shennitbaer lemala.

Nokri shehebi beshabbat o beyom tob shelleachar hashshabbat perot sheenan neekalin chayyim, apillu im yadua shennilqetu bishbil nokri, ella sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma nitleshu beshabbat, venokri zeh o acher mesiach lepi tummo shennitleshu meereb shabbat — en somekin alayv leoklam beyom tob shelleachar hashshabbat, shehen asurim bo bayyom min hattora. Veen somekim al nokri mesiach lepi tummo ella beissur dibre soperim, kegon leoklam beyom tob sheni shechal bemotzae shabbat, apillu hu yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, sheissuro eno ella middibre soperim, o apillu beyom tob rishon shechal bemotzae shabbat im hen perot hanneekalim chayyim, o lehattiran bo bayyom shehebian im hebian beshabbat, sheen yom tob rishon samuk lo millepanayv, o beyom tob sheen shabbat samuk lo millepanayv, shebbekol ellu en shum chashash hakana shel tora. Veayyen besimman tqy"g ematay somekin al nokri mesiach lepi tummo.

Nokri shehebi lair dabar sheen bemino bimchubbar veeno mechussar tzida, dehaynu shehebi perot yebeshim, o behemot veopot sheenan mechussarin tzida, kegon avvazim vetarnegolim, im mittok hattechum hebiam — muttarim lakkol, ap lemi shehubeu bishbilo, kemo shennitbaer lemala, abal im michutz lattechum hebiam, dehaynu shebbitchillat kenisat yom tob hayu adayin chutz lattechum — hare asurin baakila bo bayyom lemi shehubeu bishbilo ulekol anshe beto hassemukim al shulchano, sheggam bishbilam nitkavven hannokri bahabaato, velaereb tzerikim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, dehaynu sheyyishheh kol kak kemo sheshshaha hannokri bahabaato otam mimmaqom shehechshik lo hayyom beereb yom tob ad shehebi otam letok ibburah shel ir shel hayyisrael, dehaynu maqom shemmishsham matchilin limdod techume hair, kemo shennitbaer besimman [sh]tz"ch ayyen sham.

Hattaam shehitzriku chakamim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu eno bishbil shello yehaneh mimmeleket yom tob, shehare eno neheneh kelal miggup hammelaka, dehaynu hahalika michutz lattechum, ella hu neheneh mehaddabar shennaasa bo hammelaka abal lo min gup hammelaka beatzmah, ulepikak lo hayu chakamim matzrikim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, velama hitzriku lehamtin? Mishshum gezera shemma yomar lenokri sheyyabi lo mine maakal michutz lattechum beyom tob kede lemaher akilato ballayla, vekevan sheqqanesu oto beshaa shemmin haddin haya muttar lo leekol, dehaynu bemotzae yom tob — shub lo yomar lenokri lehabi lo.

Vaapillu im motzae yom tob hu shabbat o yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana o yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, sheap sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu ap al pi ken yesh lachush shemma yomar lenokri sheyyabi lo beyom tob rishon kede leekol beyom tob sheni o beshabbat shelleacharayv leachar sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu bemotzae yom tob rishon, mikkol maqom lo ratzu chakamim leqonso kol kak shello yokal ad motzae shabbat o ad motzae yom tob sheni, dekevan sheissur techumin hu qal, sheeno nitqan bishbil seyag leissur shel tora, lepikak heqellu bo, veday im qenasuhu shello yokal bo bayyom shehebiu lo ubikde sheyyeasu bayyom shelleacharayv.

Vekol zeh lemi shehuba bishbilo uleanshe beto, abal lishar kol adam muttar baakila apillu bo bayyom shehebi michutz lattechum, dekevan sheissur techumim hu qal — heqellu bo shello leesor ella lemi shehuba bishbilo. Vaapillu im hebi hannokri michutz leg' parsaot, sheyyesh omerim dibg' parsaot yesh issur techumin min hattora, ap al pi ken kevan shei epshar leesor lekol bene adam beshaveh, shehare issur techumin hu eno shaveh lekol bene adam, shemmah shehu chutz litchumo shel zeh hu tok techumo shel zeh, vekevan shehutzreku chakamim lechalleq beissur zeh leesor lezeh ulehattir lezeh — asu od chilluq ben mi shehuba bishbilo lemi shello huba bishbilo, sheen rauy leesor lo, mittaam shennitbaer leel.

Vekevan shehu rauy laakila bo bayyom lemi shello huba bishbilo, lepikak ap mi shehuba bishbilo muttar letaltelo beyom tob, veen lo din muqtzeh kelal, kevan sherauy laacherim bo bayyom. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yetaltelennu chutz led' ammot bemaqom sheasur letaltel beshabbat, ben hu ben acher shello huba bishbilo. Veap al pi shehuttar lo leoklo bo bayyom, mikkol maqom lo huttar lo lehotzi chutz led' ammot bekarmelit apillu letzorek akila, kegon sherotzeh lebashshelo vei epshar lo lebashshelo ella im ken yotziennu chutz mid' ammot bekarmelit — asur lo lehotzio apillu al yede nokri, vaapillu huba letzorek nokri, dekevan sheyyatza chutz lattechum — en lo ella d' ammot, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"a. Abal bemaqom shemmuttar letaltel sham beshabbat, kegon bechatzer, o bair shettiqqenu mebooteha belechi o qora o tzurat happetach, o shehi muqqepet choma, veken mibtzar, shehu beinyan shemmuttar letaltel bo beshabbat, kegon sheyyadua sheyyashab (perush shebbanu bo battim ledira) velibsop huqqap kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch vet"a — muttar letaltel bahen gam ken mah shehuba michutz lattechum, dekol reshut shemmuttar letaltel bo beshabbat — hare kullo nechshab ked' ammot leinyan yotze chutz lattechum, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"h ayyen sham.

Vekol zeh kesheyyadua beberur shehebi beyom tob michutz lattechum bishbil yisrael, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma bitchillat kenisat yom tob haya hannokri kebar betok techum hair — yesh lehaqel beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot ap lemi shehuba bishbilo, kevan sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot, shehare yom tob sheni iqqar taqqanato mechamat hassapeq. Abal beyom tob rishon yesh lehachamir ap besapeq, kevan shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin".

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannokri shehebi haddoron hu dar chutz lair, o shehu dar bair ella shepperotayv hen chutz lair, abal nokri haddar bair veyesh lo perot bair kayyotze baellu shehebi lehayyisrael — muttar ap lemi shehuba bishbilo, apillu hu yom tob rishon, lepi sheen kan sapeq kelal ella hu bevadday, demin hassetam hebi mipperotayv shebbair. Vaapillu yesh lehannokri b' battim ubahen perot, echad mehen tok hattechum vehab' chutz lattechum — en chosheshin shemma hebi meotan shechutz lattechum, ella min hassetam hebi meotan shebbetok hattechum shehen qerobim yoter lair.

Vekol zeh benokri shehebi doron leyisrael, abal nokri shehebi limkor, im rob hair hen nokrim — bevadday letzorek hannokri hebi, umuttar liqqach mimmennu (al derek shennitbaer besimman shk"g ayyen sham) veleekol apillu beyom tob rishon, im hu dabar sheen bemino bimchubbar veeno mechussar tzida. Veim hu dabar sheyyesh bemino bimchubbar o mechussar tzida — muttar baakila laereb miyyad, veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu kedin mebi letzorek nokri, dekevan sherob hair hen nokrim — min hassetam hebi letzorek rob anshe hair. Veim anu roim sheim nattir liqqach mimmennu beyom tob yarbeh lehabi od beyom tob ap letzorek yisrael — asur liqqach mimmennu beyom tob ap al pi sherob hair hen nokrim. Abal min hassetam en chosheshin shemma yarbeh lehabi gam bishbil yisrael, umuttar liqqach mimmennu beir sherubbah nokrim. Umikkol maqom, nokri hammebi dagim limkor beir sherubbah nokrim — ap bistam yesh lachush sheyyarbeh lehabi bishbil yisrael im anu mattirin liqqach mimmennu, kevan shedderek yisrael liqnot dagim likbod yom tob. Vetzarik lehityashsheb bedabar zeh, ki hakkol lepi reot ene hammoreh.

Abal hair shechetzyah nokrim vechetzyah yisrael, nokri hammebi sham limkor bevadday letzorek shenehem hu mebi, vekevan shekkavvanato gam letzorek yisrael — hare dino kedin nokri shehebi doron leyisrael (sheim yesh bemino bimchubbar tzarik kol adam lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu ap mi shello huba bishbilo, veim en bemino bimchubbar ella shehuba michutz lattechum — muttar lemi shello huba bishbilo, dehaynu mi sheeno meanshe hair uba lair achar shekkebar haya hannokri betok techum hair).

Vekol zeh keshehannokri shehebi limkor hu dar beir zo shemmoker bah vehebi mipperotayv shechutz lattechum, abal im hu dar bikpar chutz lair, apillu im harob hen yisrael vehebi lesham dabar sheyyesh bemino bimchubbar o mechussar tzida — dino kedin mebi leir sherubbah nokrim, dekevan shehu dar michutz lair anu holekim achar rob haolam, veanu omerim shemmin hassetam liqqetan vetzadan letzorek nokrim shehen rob haolam veachar kak nimlak vehebian leir zo. Lepikak, im hebian mittok hattechum — muttar laereb miyyad, kedin perot shennilqetu bishbil nokri. Veim hebian michutz lattechum — muttarim laereb achar shehimtin bikde sheyyeasu, ap im hu shabbat o yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana o shel galuyyot, kedin dabar sheen bemino bimchubbar shehuba letzorek yisrael michutz lattechum.

Yisrael sheqqatzatz damim lenokri sheyyabi lo dagim beereb yom tob bead sekum damim ellu sheqqatzatz lo venishtaha hannokri vehebian beyom tob, im hu beinyan sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma nitztzodu beyom tob — hare ellu asurin baakila ubetiltul ad haereb, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal baereb yesh lehistappeq im tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, lepi sheyyesh lomar shello hitzriku chakamim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu bimlaka hannaaset beyom tob bishbil yisrael ella im hu beinyan sheim neesor [le]hayyisrael lehanot mimmelaka zo ad leachar sheyyamtin baereb bikde sheyyeasu azay lo yaaseh hannokri hammelaka beyom tob ad haereb beshaa shehayyisrael rashshay lehanot mimmenna, kegon shehayyisrael lo qatzatz im hannokri sheyyaaseh melaka zo bishbilo, ella hannokri middaat atzmo hu oseh ken letzorek hayyisrael, veillu haya yodea hannokri shehayyisrael lo yehaneh mimmenna beyom tob bevadday lo haya mezarez et atzmo laasotah beyom tob, venimtza keshehannokri oseh otah beyom tob bevadday oseh otah ledaat ken sheyyehaneh mimmenna hayyisrael beyom tob, lepikak qenasuhu chakamim shello yehaneh mimmenna beyom tob atzmo vegam laereb ad leachar sheyyamtin bikde sheyyeasu, abal keshehayyisrael qatzatz im hannokri meereb yom tob sheyyaaseh lo melaka zo, veap im neesor lehayyisrael lehanot mimmelaka zo ap al pi ken yaasenna hannokri lehashlim qetzitzato velittol damayv mehayyisrael, nimtza keshehannokri oseh hammelaka beyom tob eno oseh otah bishbil sheyyehaneh mimmenna hayyisrael beyom tob atzmo, ella bishbil atzmo hu mezarez et atzmo lemaher melakto, lepikak epshar shezzehu domeh leqatzatz im hannokri meereb shabbat sheyyaaseh lo minalim vehebian lo hannokri beshabbat shehen muttarim lehayyisrael bo bayyom, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b ayyen sham. Ukebar nitbaer sham deyesh oserin lilbosh hamminalim ad sheyyamtin bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, uledibrehem ap dagim ellu asurin ad motzae yom tob bikde sheyyeasu. Abal leachar kede sheyyeasu epshar shehen muttarim ap im hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, kemo shennitbaer leinyan hamminalim. Veim yadua sheddagim ellu nitztzodu meereb yom tob ella shehebian beyom tob michutz lattechum, kevan sheen kan issur muqtzeh — epshar shehen muttarim ap bo bayyom lehammattirin gabbe minalim. Ukebar bearnu sham shebbishat haddechaq (shehu tzarik leminalim ellu beshabbat) yesh lismok al hammattirin, ayyen sham kol peratim ellu.

Yisrael sheshshigger doron lachabero al yede nokri meereb yom tob vehebi hannokri et haddoron lachabero beyom tob michutz lattechum, im yisrael hashsholeach hu yodea shei epshar sheyyaggia haddoron leyad chabero ella im ken yelek hannokri beyom tob chutz lattechum — hare zeh asur baakila lemi shehuba bishbilo (uleanshe beto), velaereb tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kevan shennaasa issur bishbilo. Abal im hashsholeach lo yada sheyyelek hannokri beyom tob chutz lattechum, shehaya lo shahut lehaggia lesham mibbeod yom venitakkeb hashshaliach badderek vehebi beyom tob michutz lattechum — hare zeh muttar baakila ap lemi shehuba bishbilo, shehare en hannokri mebi mishshello kede shennigzor shemma yomar lo: habe li michutz lattechum, ella mishshel yisrael acher hu mebi, vehayyisrael lo yishma elayv lishloach lo beyom tob michutz lattechum, sheen adam chote velo lo. Raq shetztzarik lizzaher shello yetaltelennu chutz ld' ammot bemaqom sheasur letaltel sham beshabbat, vaapillu im lo huba bishbilo, vaapillu al yede nokri, kemo shennitbaer lemala.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar sheen bemino bimchubbar veeno mechussar tzida, abal im haddoron hu dabar sheyyesh bemino bimchubbar o mechussar tzida — asur leqabbelo miyyad hannokri beyom tob, ap al pi shehannokri yatza mibbet yisrael hamshalleach meereb yom tob veim ken doron zeh nilqat venitztzod meereb yom tob, mikkol maqom yesh lachush shemma hechelip hannokri et haddoron beperot shennilqetu hayyom, ulepikak en leqabbel mimmennu ella im ken chatum betok chotam echad, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman qy"ch ayyen sham.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyisrael sheshshigger doron lachabero mishshello, shemmeqabbel haddoron eno yodea im mah sheshshigger lo chabero haya tob veyapeh yoter mimmah shehebi lo hannokri o lav, ulepikak yesh lachush shemma haya tob yoter vehechelipo hannokri bera mimmennu (shennilqat venitztzod beyom tob), kevan shehu neheneh bachalipin. Abal yisrael sheqqana meereb yom tob dabar sheyyesh bemino bimchubbar o mechussar tzida vehinnicho beyad hannokri belo chotam ad lemachar, ulemachar raa shehu tob veyapeh kemo harishon shehinniach etzlo, ap al pi sheeno makkir bitbiut ayin shezzehu harishon shehinniach etzlo — muttar, veen anu chosheshim shemma hechelipo hannokri, kevan sheeno neheneh bachalipin, shehare zeh hu kol kak tob veyapeh kemo harishon shehinniach etzlo.
